question: What do we know about the generational wealth transfer, and how are these five preparing for it?

cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James' Private Wealth Advisor Program offers education, training, and accreditation along with enhanced capabilities and product solutions to enable advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients.
items.quote: our Private Wealth Advisor Program offers education, training, and accreditation along with enhanced capabilities and product solutions. This enables advisors to meet the needs of their most sophisticated clients

items.text: Raymond James' private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform support advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: our private wealth advisor program and expanded alternative investments platform supports advisors who focus on high-net-worth clients

items.text: Raymond James launched Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model portfolio framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies for high-net-worth clients.
items.quote: the firm announced the launch of Private Wealth Guided Portfolios, a risk-based model framework that combines equity and fixed income allocations with a dedicated alternatives sleeve covering private markets and hedged strategies

items.text: Raymond James launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program for small business owners, partnering with Capital Group American Funds, designed for small businesses with up to 100 employees.
items.quote: The firm has launched a firm-wide SIMPLE IRA Employer Advisory and Consulting Services Program... partnered with Capital Group American Funds for the program, which is designed for small businesses with up to 100 employees

items.text: Raymond James opened up Bitcoin ETFs on a limited basis for advisors and their clients.
items.quote: We have opened up on a limited basis the ETFs, the Bitcoin ETFs for advisors and their clients.

items.text: Raymond James brought in bespoke private investment alternatives for ultra-high net worth clients in response to growing demand for private investment product alternatives.
items.quote: In response to growing demand for private investment product alternatives for ultra-high net worth clients, we further developed the firm's private capital raising expertise and brought in bespoke private investment alternatives for such clients.

items.text: Raymond James announced a new leadership structure for its private capital business to help high-net-worth focused advisors better serve their clients with a wide variety of bespoke private investment alternatives.
items.quote: we also announced a new leadership structure for our private capital business to help high-net-worth focus advisors better serve their clients with a wide variety of bespoke private investment alternatives

items.text: Raymond James' Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched September 2022, provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients, generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets; nearly 450 advisors had earned the designation as of September 2026.
items.quote: the firm's Raymond James Private Wealth Advisor designation program, launched in September 2022, which provides training, coaching, and a peer network for advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets. As of September 2026, nearly 450 advisors have earned the designation
items.definition: advisors who specialize in high-net-worth clients - generally defined as those with at least $5 million in investable assets

items.text: Raymond James' high-net-worth effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, positioned as tools advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.
items.quote: That effort includes estate and charitable planning capabilities, lending and cash management solutions, risk management services, and intergenerational wealth strategies, all positioned as tools that advisors can draw on when serving households with complex financial profiles.

items.text: Raymond James offers an Enhanced Savings Program, a high-yield Raymond James Bank deposit account, and an open platform of higher-yielding alternatives including purchase money market funds with institutional share class access.
items.quote: we've been offering one of the most open platforms of higher-yielding alternatives, whether it's the enhanced savings program... as well as the purchase money market funds, which we let all clients avail themselves to the institutional share class

cells.reason: Multiple passages describe products, services and platforms (private wealth program, guided portfolios, alternatives, retirement plans, digital assets, deposit/cash offerings, estate/intergenerational planning) that Raymond James offers to attract and serve high-net-worth and next-generation clientele.
